CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION uqn_fix.hkm30_clean(s text) RETURNS text LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE AS $f$
  SELECT btrim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(replace(s, chr(160), ' '), '[ 	]+', ' ', 'g'), ' ?
 ?', E'
', 'g'), '
{3,}', E'

', 'g'), E' 
')
$f$
